topic: Exchanging a Sweater Bought Online at the Store

script.title: EXCHANGING A SWEATER
script.scene_zh: 門市收銀台 · 網購換貨
script.story_hook: A sweater bought online now wants a new home.
script.intro_zh: 線上買的毛衣穿不了，現在想有個新家。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's return counter scene. Listen for exchange phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的退貨櫃台場景。留意換貨與退款的說法。
script.outro: That's a return desk handled like a pro. Play it again, echo every line.
script.outro_zh: 退貨櫃台這一回合處理得專業又漂亮。再撥一次，逐句大聲跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: I liked the color, but it itches
script.char_a_description: a man in his forties with a thick dark beard, closely cropped greying hair at the temples, an olive green field jacket over a striped rugby shirt, brown corduroy pants, and a heavyset build
script.char_b_description: a woman in her early twenties with a chin-length bright red bob, a silver nose stud, a black store polo with rolled sleeves, a crimson apron with a name patch, and a small frame

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, is this the counter for returns?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈkaʊɾɚ fɚ ɹɪˈtɜɹnz/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，退換貨是在這個櫃台辦嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, what did we buy, or un-buy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz wʌt dɪd wi baɪ ɔɹ ˌʌnˈbaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，我們買了什麼，還是想退掉什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, a sweater, online, size large, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ə ˈswɛɾɚ ˌɑnˈaɪn saɪz lɑɹdʒ ˈsædli/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，一件毛衣，在線上買的，可惜買大了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gray one with the little ducks?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡɹeɪ wʌn wɪð ðə ˈlɪɾəl dʌks/
dialogue.zh: 是那件有小鴨圖案的灰色毛衣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ducks yes, though they looked smarter online.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌks jɛs ðoʊ ðeɪ lʊkt ˈsmɑɹtɚ ˌɑnˈaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對，小鴨子，不過在螢幕上牠們看起來聰明多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, photos flatter, what's the real issue?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈfoʊtoʊz ˈflætɚ wʌts ðə ɹiəl ˈɪʃu/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，照片總是會修圖，真正的問題是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I liked the color, but it itches.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ laɪkt ðə ˈkʌlɚ bʌt ɪt ˈɪtʃəz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我喜歡那個顏色，可是穿上很癢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bummer, wool blend, it bites some folks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌmɚ wʊl blɛnd ɪt baɪts sʌm foʊks/
dialogue.zh: 真可惜，是羊毛混紡，有些人穿了會刺癢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, my neck started a small protest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli maɪ nɛk ˈstɑɹtəd ə smɔl ˈpɹoʊtɛst/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，我的脖子當場發動了一場小抗爭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair protest, do you have the receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ˈpɹoʊtɛst du ju hæv ðə ɹɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 抗爭有理。手上有收據或訂單資料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not paper, um, it was all online.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈpeɪpɚ ʌm ɪt wɔz ɔl ˌɑnˈaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 沒有紙本，嗯，全部都是線上完成的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, do you have the QR code?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ du ju hæv ðə ˌkjuˈɑɹ ˈkoʊd/
dialogue.zh: 好的，那你有退貨用的 QR code 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The what? My phone is right here, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌt maɪ foʊn ɪz ɹaɪt hɪɹ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 什麼？我手機就在我手上啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, open the email, tap return code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ˈoʊpən ði ˈimeɪl tæp ɹɪˈtɜɹn koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，打開那封電子郵件，點「退貨碼」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, searching, um, subject, order seven...
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ˈsɜrtʃɪŋ ʌm ˈsʌbdʒɛk ˈɔɹdɚ ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我找找，主旨寫著訂單七……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's at the top, with the little box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts æt ðə tɑp wɪð ðə ˈlɪɾəl ˈbɑks/
dialogue.zh: 它在最上面，旁邊還有個小方框。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it! Does this square thing work?
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt dʌz ðɪs skwɛɹ θɪŋ wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 找到了！這個方方的東西有用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the one, hold it near my scanner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə wʌn hoʊld ɪt nɪɹ maɪ ˈskænɚ/
dialogue.zh: 就是那個，拿到我的掃描機前面照一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, did it beep? I heard no beep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm dɪd ɪt bip aɪ hɜɹd noʊ bip/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，它嗶了一聲嗎？我完全沒聽見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, tilt it up, the light is shy.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈloʊst tɪlt ɪt ʌp ðə laɪt ɪz ʃaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 差一點，往上傾斜一些，它的光線有點害羞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, one happy beep, you're good at this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ wʌn ˈhæpi bip jʊɹz ɡʊd æt ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 有了，開心的一聲嗶，你真熟悉這套流程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten years of tag reading, so, exchange?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn jɪɹz ʌv tæɡ ˈɹiɾɪŋ soʊ ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 我做這行十年，最會看吊牌。所以，是要換貨？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or refund, honestly, which is easier?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɹ ɹɪˈfʌnd ˈɑnəstli wɪtʃ ɪz ˈiziɚ/
dialogue.zh: 還是退款，老實說，哪一種比較省事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Refund is fast, it flies back to your card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈfʌnd ɪz fæst ɪt flaɪz bæk tə jɔɹ kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 退款很快，錢會飛回你的信用卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How fast, a day, a week, a season?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fæst ə deɪ ə wik ə ˈsizən/
dialogue.zh: 多快呢，一天、一週，還是一季？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three days, maybe five, banks are mysterious.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi deɪz ˈmeɪbi faɪv bæŋkz ɑɹ məˈstɪɹiəs/
dialogue.zh: 大概三天，也可能五天，銀行總愛演推理劇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, banks, sure. What about store credit?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ bæŋks ʃʊɹ wʌt əˈbaʊt stɔɹ ˈkɹɛdɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，銀行嘛，好吧。那店內購物金呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Instant, and you can spend it online today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪnstənt ænd ju kæn spɛnd ɪt ˌɑnˈaɪn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這個馬上就到，今天就能在線上使用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tempting, but my neck has a long memory.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɛmpɪŋ bʌt maɪ nɛk hæz ə lɔŋ ˈmɛməɹi/
dialogue.zh: 好誘人，不過我的脖子記仇，還記得那次癢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, trauma, I get it. Want the medium?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈtɹɑmə aɪ ɡɛt ɪt wɑnt ðə ˈmidiəm/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，算是一種陰影，我懂。要換中尺碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Medium, yes, does the gray come in medium?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidiəm jɛs dʌz ðə ɡɹeɪ kʌm ɪn ˈmidiəm/
dialogue.zh: 中尺碼，對了，灰色有中尺碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check, um, back room, one sec.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ʌm bæk ɹum wʌn sɛk/
dialogue.zh: 我查一下，嗯，在倉庫裡，稍等我一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time, I'll pet the display scarves.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔɹ taɪm aɪl pɛt ðə dɪˈspleɪ skɑɹvz/
dialogue.zh: 不急，我先摸摸展示用的圍巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They never bite, yes, here's your gray medium.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈnɛvɚ baɪt jɛs hɪɹz jɔɹ ɡɹeɪ ˈmidiəm/
dialogue.zh: 圍巾都不會咬人。有了，你的灰色中尺碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, nice, and the tag is still attached.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs ænd ðə tæɡ ɪz stɪl əˈtætʃt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，真好，標籤還好好地掛著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh stock, that helps, is this your size?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹæʃ stɑk ðæt hɛlps ɪz ðɪs jɔɹ ˈsaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 全新庫存最好，這個尺碼是你穿的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, my arms feel like windmill blades here.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm maɪ ɑɹmz fil laɪk ˈwɪndˌmɪl ˈbleɪdz hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我的手臂在裡面像風車的槳葉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try it on, the mirror is right behind you.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹaɪ ɪt ɑn ðə ˈmɪɹɚ ɪz ɹaɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ju/
dialogue.zh: 穿上試試，鏡子就在你身後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't, um, is there a fitting room?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kænt ʌm ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈfɪɾɪŋ ɹum/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡不太方便，嗯，有試衣間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two steps, left, the curtain sticks, pull hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu stɛps lɛft ðə ˈkɝtən stɪks pʊl hɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 兩步路，左邊，試衣間的簾子愛卡住，要用力拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Charming, be right back, hold my coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɑɹmɪŋ bi ɹaɪt bæk hoʊd maɪ ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 真有特色，等我一下，幫我拿一下咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One sec, your cup has a note on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn sɛk jɔɹ kʌp hæz ə noʊt ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 稍等，你的杯子上貼了張字條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's my son's school list, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts maɪ sʌnz skul lɪst ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那是我兒子的學校清單，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, happens, the sweater fits, you look warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈhæpənz ðə ˈswɛɾɚ fɪts ju lʊk wɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，常有的事。毛衣很合身，你看起來暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It fits, and wow, this one doesn't itch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fɪts ænd waʊ ðɪs wʌn ˈdʌzənt ɪtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 真的合身，而且哇，這件完全不癢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cotton blend, our itch-free line, proud of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑtən blɛnd ˈaʊɚ ˈɪtʃˌfri laɪn pɹaʊd əv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這是棉質混紡，我們的不癢系列，我挺自豪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Proud is good, can I see the cotton scarves?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɹaʊd ɪz ɡʊd kən aɪ si ðə ˈkɑtən skɑɹvz/
dialogue.zh: 自豪是好事，那我能看看棉質圍巾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the blue ones match this gray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ðə blu wʌnz mætʃ ðɪs ɡɹeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，藍色那組跟這件灰色很相配。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dangerous, my wallet already sighed today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪndʒɚəs maɪ ˈwʌlət ɔlˈɹɛdi saɪd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好危險，我的錢包今天已經嘆過氣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The scarf is forty percent off, it's Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skɑɹf ɪz ˈfɔɹti pɚˈsɛnt ɔf ɪts ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 圍巾現在打六折，因為今天是週五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, you're a sales wizard, fine, add one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ jʊɹz ə seɪlz ˈwɪzɚd faɪn æd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，你根本是銷售魔法師，好吧，再加一條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One blue scarf, total sixty-eight dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn blu skɑɹf ˈtoʊɾəl ˈsɪksti eɪt ˈdɑləɹz/
dialogue.zh: 一條藍色圍巾，總共六十八美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's more than I planned, um, card works?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts mɔɹ ðæn aɪ plænd ʌm kɑɹd wɝks/
dialogue.zh: 比我原本規劃的多了一點，刷卡可以吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card works, the sweater refund is in motion.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd wɝks ðə ˈswɛɾɚ ɹɪˈfʌnd ɪz ɪn ˈmoʊʃən/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡沒問題，毛衣的退款也已經在路上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, and tell the ducks their shift is over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ænd tɛl ðə dʌks ðɛɹ ʃɪft ɪz ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，就跟小鴨說，你們下班了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, the ducks say goodbye, do you want a bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðə dʌks seɪ ˌɡʊdˈbaɪ du ju wɑnt ə bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，跟小鴨說再見。要袋子裝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, paper, um, and a receipt for this.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈpeɪpɚ ʌm ænd ə ɹɪˈsit fɔɹ ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 好，紙袋，嗯，再附上一張收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, next time feel the wool before buying.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn nɛkst taɪm fil ðə wʊl bɪˈfɔɹ ˈbaɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 搞定。下次記得先摸一摸羊毛再下手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lesson learned, thank you for the patient work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛsən lɜɹnd θæŋk ju fɔɹ ðə ˈpeɪʃənt wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 學到一課了，謝謝你這麼有耐心地幫我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, may your neck live in peace now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪˌtaɪm meɪ jɔɹ nɛk lɪv ɪn pis naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，願你的頸部從此安寧無擾。

script.youtube_title: 【網購毛衣換貨🧥】「我喜歡那個顏色，可是它會癢」🧣換貨、退款與購物金怎麼說🎧｜聽完就會退換｜60句沉浸式A2英文聽力｜Exchanging a Sweater
script.youtube_title_en: "I Liked the Color, but It Itches" — Exchanging a Sweater Bought Online
script.youtube_description:
「我喜歡那個顏色，可是它會癢」——線上買的毛衣不合身，走進門市收銀台，換貨、退款、店內購物金該怎麼問？本集是 60 句沉浸式英文聽力練習，場景就在服飾店的退貨櫃台。

你會聽到：在電子郵件裡找退貨 QR code、掃碼一直失敗的應變、換貨與退款的差別、購物金與信用卡退款的速度，還有標籤、試衣間、尺碼與附加購買的自然說法。整段只用 A2 初級單字，搭配美國人每天的自然語感：um、well、so、ha、hmm、wow。

聽完你就會用：Is this the counter for returns、What about store credit、Does the gray come in medium、Try it on。後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱，開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"I liked the color, but it itches" — the sweater arrived from online, looked great, and now your neck is filing a complaint. This 60-line immersive English listening practice happens at a clothing store's return counter.

You will hear: finding the QR return code in your email, the scanner that refuses to beep, exchange versus refund, store credit versus a card refund, tags, sizes, the fitting room, and one unplanned scarf.

Everything stays in A2 words with the small talk Americans actually use: um, well, so, ha, hmm, wow. By the end you'll own lines like What about store credit and Does the gray come in medium.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
線上買的毛衣顏色漂亮，穿上卻渾身發癢，站在服飾店的退貨櫃台前，你該怎麼開口？退貨碼藏在電子郵件的哪個角落？換貨和退款，哪一種比較快拿到錢？

這一集帶大家走進門市收銀台，從找退貨 QR code、掃碼失敗、比較換貨與退款，一路聽到尺碼、標籤、試衣間，最後還多帶一條圍巾回家，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🧾 退貨開場：Hi, is this the counter for returns?
📱 退貨碼：Perfect, open the email, tap return code.
💳 退款比較：Or refund, honestly, which is easier?
🧥 換尺碼：Medium, yes, does the gray come in medium?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so、wow 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用啃文法，多聽就會用。跟著這張退貨單走一趟櫃台，下次再遇到不合身的網購，你就能冷靜開口。

祝你下次開箱，尺寸剛剛好，也一點都不癢。
